lemma frattini_le_coatom {K : Subgroup G} (h : IsCoatom K) : frattini G ≤ K :=

    frattini G ≤ (frattini H).comap φ := by
  simp_rw [frattini, Order.radical, comap_iInf, le_iInf_iff]
  intro M hM
  apply biInf_le
  exact isCoatom_comap_of_surjective hφ hM
